title: Make staleness a property of EVIDENCE, and stop the adviser proposing or exporting an expired free claim
objective: PR #79 stopped a stale snapshot sustaining a free claim on ONE surface: GET /catalogue/categories. Every other surface still repeats the claim, because staleness is modelled as a property of published offer_version rows reached through a single query, not as a property of evidence. The adviser is the worst case and had never been measured: /adviser/recommend actively PROPOSES an expired Z0_TRUE_FREE, and /adviser/export writes it into a deployment bundle that LEAVES THE SYSTEM and outlives the evidence behind it. This slice introduces the missing abstraction -- evidence currency, recomputed at read time against a caller-supplied clock -- and applies it to the three adviser endpoints. The catalogue read surfaces are a separate slice; the declaration-source gap is a third.
measured_premise: P1 MEASURED: base re-derived with `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` = ee719f7280103c38dba3c4509f6e05d01ae3149d, equal to the SHA the brief stated. Confirmed rather than trusted.

P2 MEASURED baseline against an ISOLATED PostgreSQL 16 (own container, port 55433, own volume -- never the shared freetier-atlas-postgres-1 on 5432): `pytest tests/unit tests/integration -q` -> 2666 passed, 3 skipped, exit 0. NOTE: this baseline OMITTED tests/security, which later cost me a missed monkeypatch signature; see D3.

P3 MEASURED the adviser exposure, which the brief and the PR #79 evaluator both stated as a STRUCTURAL read and explicitly declined to assert. With expired evidence: /adviser/recommend returns fully_zero_cost=true and /adviser/export returns manifest.fully_zero_cost=true with Z0_TRUE_FREE inside MANIFEST.json and a README asserting '$0 proof: every component below is classified Z0_TRUE_FREE'. The whole bundle contained ZERO occurrences of 'stale' or 'fresh'.

P4 MEASURED the trap the brief warned about: build_candidate re-runs the classifier and marks disagreement as CONTRADICTION, so it LOOKS like a guard. pool.excluded was EMPTY in both the stale and the fresh direction. Both sides read the same frozen material_facts and agree perfectly on evidence that expired years ago. It compares two classifications, never evidence age.

P5 MEASURED the aggravating fact on the serializer path: for expired evidence, GET /offers/{id} advanced.signals.freshness = 1.0, GET /providers/{slug} freshness = 1.0, GET /providers freshness = 1.0, and OfferDetail carries no field whose name contains 'stale'. Confirmed 1.0 is genuinely what the pipeline freezes rather than a number invented for the fixture: publish/confidence.freshness_ratio(0s, window) = 1.0 for both a 1-second and a 30-day window, and publisher.py:188 computes it at PUBLISH time.

P6 MEASURED the declaration-source split independently of the orchestrator's figure, over all seven shipped provider configs (cloudflare is F005; aws/azure/gcp/github/oracle/vercel are the six merged F008 providers): 7 verified_free declarations, 5 carrying a `source`, 2 carrying `evidence_url` ONLY -- cloudflare|networking-cdn-dns and github|ai-inference-embeddings. Those two have no Source, hence no schedule, hence no Snapshot, hence no fetched_at, so assess_staleness has no timestamp to compare and they are time-invariant. This is why the declaration gap is a SEPARATE slice: it needs a signal to exist, not a clock to be threaded.

P7 MEASURED REAL-INPUT REACHABILITY through the real ingest+publish pipeline over committed fixtures for all seven providers: 6 published offer versions (5 Z0_TRUE_FREE, 1 Z2_TEMPORARY_OR_CONDITIONAL -- the GHEC trial), and EVERY Z0 published offer has evidence with a checkable fetched_at. This is what made the strict gate safe: refusing 'currency could not be established' withdraws nothing real. Offer ids are DB-local auto-increment values and are deliberately NOT quoted as identifiers.

P8 MEASURED both directions on real input: at `now` the adviser pool holds 5 Z0 candidates with confidence 'high' and an empty stale partition; at `now+5y` it holds 0 Z0 and 5 stale with confidence 'unknown', and the recommendation states 'last fetched 1824 days ago, past its 7 days refresh window'.

P9 MEASURED, first time ever observed: the DB CHECK ck_provider_category_coverage_claimed_offer_requires_evidence FIRES. A raw INSERT of a verified_free declaration with neither source_id nor evidence_url is rejected with a CheckViolation naming the constraint, while a NEGATIVE CONTROL insert carrying evidence_url is accepted -- so the rejection is the constraint, not an unwritable table. Reported as a measurement; nothing was changed.

abstraction_introduced.why_not_a_boolean: A single `stale` flag cannot distinguish 'we looked and it expired' (checked=True, stale=True) from 'there was nothing to look at' (checked=False, stale=False). Collapsing them is exactly how the declaration-source gap hides: an evidence_url-only declaration would read as fresh. UNCHECKED is fail-closed for a free claim but is NOT reported as stale, because absence of a timestamp is not evidence of expiry either.
abstraction_introduced.no_migration: No schema change, no Alembic revision, no stored projection. Currency is recomputed on every read against a caller-supplied `now`, per decision Q11 as restated in read_api/coverage.py: a stored projection becomes a second source of truth that silently goes stale, which is the precise failure being fixed. Persisting freshness at publish time is what made a five-year-expired claim report 1.0.
abstraction_introduced.backward_compatibility: fetch_stale_offer_version_ids keeps its exact signature and semantics and is reimplemented as a projection of fetch_evidence_currency, so PR #79's /catalogue/categories path is behaviourally untouched.

acceptance_criteria: AC1 A Z0_TRUE_FREE offer whose evidence is past its refresh window does not enter CandidatePool.z0.
AC2 PAIRED CONTROL: an otherwise identical offer whose evidence is inside its window DOES enter z0. Without this the refusal could be a gate that rejects everything.

AC3 A stale Z0 offer is routed to an explicit `stale` partition, not silently dropped, and is still surfaced to the user as the closest candidate with a stated reason. Suppressing a free offer is its own defect.
AC4 /adviser/recommend returns fully_zero_cost=false for an expired claim and states the age, the window, and what to do about it.
AC5 PAIRED CONTROL: /adviser/recommend still returns fully_zero_cost=true and names the provider for a freshly-evidenced free offer.
AC6 /adviser/recommend/assisted inherits the same gate through the same deterministic core.
AC7 An exported bundle carries NO Z0_TRUE_FREE claim in MANIFEST.json for an expired offer, carries no '$0 proof' line, and mentions the class only inside an explicit warning.
AC8 PAIRED CONTROL: an exported bundle for a freshly-evidenced offer still carries fully_zero_cost=true, the component with Z0_TRUE_FREE, and the '$0 proof' line.

expiry_mechanism.chosen: Mechanism D: SHRINK the source's declared refresh window (Source.schedule) instead of moving a timestamp or a clock.
expiry_mechanism.why_it_is_independent: assess_staleness decides stale = (now - fetched_at) > window. The two derivations that already established this defect both moved `age` (one backdated Snapshot.fetched_at, one advanced the clock past a real ingest). Mechanism D moves `window` -- the other side of the same inequality. In the integration tests both offers share ONE fetched_at and are read at the real wall clock through the router's own _now(), so the source window is the only variable and an error in age arithmetic could not manufacture the result.
expiry_mechanism.cross_checked_with: Mechanism A (aging the evidence) is used in the unit tests and in the real-ingest reachability probe at now+5y; both agree with Mechanism D.

known_deferred_problem: GET /catalogue/search?zero_cost_class=Z0_TRUE_FREE filters on the STORED offer.zero_cost_class column in SQL. When slice 2 changes what the read surfaces DISPLAY, the filter and the display can disagree -- a stale offer would be returned by a 'show me free things' filter while displaying as unsupported. That must be resolved inside slice 2 and is recorded here so it is not discovered as a surprise.

data_security_privacy_portability_z0.data: No migration, no schema change, no stored projection, no fixture capture edited.
data_security_privacy_portability_z0.security_privacy: No secret introduced. No registry URL or internal hostname written to any repository file, commit message, PR body or report. npm ci and npm audit fix were NOT run, so package-lock.json resolved URLs are untouched. The export validation error deliberately does not echo generated file content, asserted by test.
data_security_privacy_portability_z0.portability: No new runtime dependency, no new mandatory service. Standard library plus what the app already uses.
data_security_privacy_portability_z0.z0: This is the Z0 honesty path itself. The failure being closed is a free claim repeated after the evidence supporting it expired -- and, worse, actively proposed and written into an artefact that leaves the system. The gate is fail-closed in both non-current shapes, while the paired controls keep a genuinely free, freshly-evidenced offer fully served: a wrongly-withdrawn free offer is a defect of equal severity.

evaluation_level_rationale: Level 2 is mandatory: public user workflows and a publication decision, on the one path whose output leaves the system and outlives the evidence behind it.
